published_ranges._enclosure: strong chemical odor when printing: use proper ventilation and air exchange at all times
published_ranges._notes: Resin: SABIC CYCOLAC FR15U ABS, resin meets UL V-0. Atomic links SABIC's resin TDS, which could not be fetched (HTTP 406), so no density/HDT recorded (resin density is not the generic ABS SDS value). Sample coil page: ovality +/-0.05 mm or better.

conflicts: 3.5 kg page and sample coil page give 240-255C (https://atomicfilament.com/products/3-5kg-flame-retardant-sabic-fr15u-black-abs, https://atomicfilament.com/products/sample-coil-abs-flame-retardant-sabic-fr15u-black); 1 kg page gives 235-255C (used).
